intro: Pick what should be created. The app composes the request for the assistant — it reads the project, writes the document and you download or edit it.

presentation.popis: PowerPoint and PDF to download: goal, status, what is urgent, next steps
presentation.zprava: Make a project presentation to download as PowerPoint and PDF.

greeting.popis: Season's greetings, Christmas, birthday, anniversary — a PDF to print or send
greeting.zprava: Write a greeting card as a PDF to print.

invitation.popis: When, where and a QR link to sign up — A5 PDF
invitation.zprava: Make an invitation as a PDF.

poster.popis: A4 to print: an event, an offer, a notice
poster.zprava: Make a poster as a PDF.

certificate.popis: A formal A4 with a frame to hand over or frame
certificate.zprava: Prepare a formal thank-you or certificate as a PDF.

email.popis: An e-mail draft in Documents — PDF or Word on a letterhead
email.zprava: Write an e-mail and save it to Documents.

meeting.popis: Points for a meeting or meeting notes
meeting.zprava: Prepare meeting points and save them to Documents.

note.popis: A short text to keep at hand

summary.popis: Status, deadlines, what is stuck — to send or file
summary.zprava: Make a project summary and save it to Documents.

faktura.popis: An invoice to a client with a QR payment — PDF
faktura.zprava: Issue an invoice. Who and for what is below; ask for anything missing.

volne.popis: Say in your own words what should be created

placeholder.komu: e.g. clients, John Smith, the team
placeholder.doplneni: what to include, what to leave out…
placeholder.zadani: e.g. quote for Brown: logo 6,500 and 3 h of consulting at 900

veta.projekt: Base it on the project "{{v}}" — read it and use only facts from it.
veta.bezProjektu: No project — use only what I write and ask about anything missing.
